items.condition: The submitted catalyst is not the supplied anionic Ir trisboryl system, or charge/state/atom mapping is guessed inconsistently without disclosure.
A reported barrier uses an unvalidated transition state, multiple unexplained imaginary frequencies, or a mode unrelated to the assigned C–H/C–B event.
α and β barriers use incompatible reference states or omit enough bookkeeping that their ordering is not comparable.
Multiple pathway candidates are claimed but individual candidate identity and validation evidence are absent.
The report asserts exhaustive mechanism or quantitatively decisive oxidative-addition regioselectivity despite unreported search coverage or acknowledged method uncertainty.
